## Motivation

`test_minimax_m31_page_row_views.py::test_prefill_indexer_and_attention_match[True]`, added by [#46141](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46141) (`4991bd33ae`, the only commit on that file), fails on every PR that reaches `base-b-kernel-unit` on a runner whose CUDA Toolkit predates 13.4:

```
RuntimeError: Q8KV4 prefill attention with QMUL4 requires CUDA Toolkit 13.4 or newer; selected /usr/local/cuda-13.0 reports 13.0
```

The failure is in the test, not in serving. `MiniMaxSparseNvfp4AttnBackend.__init__` feeds `prefer_qmul4` for both the decode and the prefill plan from `msa_v1_qmul4_decode_capability()`, which already rejects a toolkit below 13.4, so the QMUL4 wrapper is only reached once that probe passes. The test hardcodes `prefer_qmul4=True` instead. The decode cases survive because their plans record `qmul4_fallback_reason` and drop to the FP8 path; the prefill wrapper JIT-builds on
first use and raises.

## Modifications

One file, +8 lines. `test_prefill_indexer_and_attention_match` calls `msa_v1_qmul4_decode_capability()` for the `prefer_qmul4=True` case and skips with the reason the probe returns. The `prefer_qmul4=False` case and both decode tests are untouched.

## Accuracy Tests

No model or kernel code changes, so no accuracy impact. On a runner with CUDA 13.4 or newer the probe passes and the case runs exactly as before; below that it now skips with `QMUL4 is unavailable: QMUL4 requires CUDA compiler >=13.4, got 13.0` instead of failing the suite. The file's fixture already skips everything off SM100/SM103.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (test-only change to an existing test)
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (n/a)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (n/a, no inference path change)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

detail.title: [Fix] attention: Skip the MSA-v1 QMUL4 prefill case when QMUL4 is unavailable

files.patch:
@@ -21,6 +21,7 @@
     MSAV1DecodeAttentionPlan,
     MSAV1DecodeIndexerPlan,
     MSAV1PrefillPlan,
+    msa_v1_qmul4_decode_capability,
 )
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.minimax_m3_nvfp4_pool import (
     MiniMaxM3Nvfp4IndexKPool,
@@ -236,6 +237,13 @@ def test_decode_indexer_and_attention_match(caches, fallback, query_length):
 @requires_msa
 @pytest.mark.parametrize("prefer_qmul4", [True, False])
 def test_prefill_indexer_and_attention_match(caches, prefer_qmul4):
+    if prefer_qmul4:
+        # The backend gates both plans on this probe. The QMUL4 prefill wrapper
+        # JIT-builds on first use and raises when a prerequisite is missing,
+        # where the decode plans fall back on their own.
+        available, reason = msa_v1_qmul4_decode_capability()
+        if not available:
+            pytest.skip(f"QMUL4 is unavailable: {reason}")
     gs = caches.main.global_scale
     q_lens = [37, 130]
     total_q = sum(q_lens)
